mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.reserve_block (block_id, area_id, seam_id, block_type, geological_reserve, recoverable_reserve, recovery_rate) VALUES (#{blockId}, #{areaId}, #{seamId}, #{blockType}, #{geologicalReserve}, #{recoverableReserve}, #{recoveryRate})
mapper.select: SELECT block_id, area_id, seam_id, block_type, geological_reserve, recoverable_reserve, recovery_rate FROM public.reserve_block WHERE block_id = #{blockId}
